name: Divisional Chart Expansion — Trimshamsha (D30) Planet-in-Sign
note: Parashari astrology only; Jaimini/KP rules are not blended into this dataset. This file is the deep-expansion layer for the D30 (Trimshamsha) divisional chart flagged as deferred in divisional_charts.json's expansion_scope_note, now generated per the project owner's instruction after Phase 3 core categories were verified. It gives the 9 planets x 12 signs planet-in-sign interpretation SPECIFIC to D30's own domain of vulnerabilities, misfortunes, and characterological weaknesses, reusing the same exaltation/own-sign/debilitation dignity table as planet_in_sign.json (D1) for consistency — a methodology confirmed valid during verification (dignity is assessed per-varga using the same fixed sign table, though results should always be read together with the D1 indication, per classical teaching). Each entry is systematically generated from (a) that dignity table, (b) the sign's classical element/modality/theme, and (c) this varga's specific domain focus — NOT independently hand-authored per item the way planet_in_sign.json's 108 D1 entries were, given the scale (12 vargas x 108 = 1,296 items total across this expansion). To use this layer for a real chart, first determine which sign each planet falls into within the D30 chart itself (see this file's calculation_note), then look up that planet-sign combination here. This file has been through an online-source verification pass (see verification_pass below); per the project owner's instruction, that pass was treated as sufficient confirmation to mark all items verified: true without a separate line-by-line manual read-through, given the combinatorial, table-derived generation method (see owner_review_pass below).
division_scheme: Each sign is divided into 30 unequal parts, ruled in sequence by five planets (Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus, in a fixed but sign-dependent order and with unequal degree spans per classical rule).
calculation_note: Verified classical (Parashara) scheme — ODD signs (Aries/Gemini/Leo/Libra/Sagittarius/Aquarius): Mars 0-5°, Saturn 5-10°, Jupiter 10-18°, Mercury 18-25°, Venus 25-30°. EVEN signs (Taurus/Cancer/Virgo/Scorpio/Capricorn/Pisces): Venus 0-5°, Mercury 5-12°, Jupiter 12-20°, Saturn 20-25°, Mars 25-30° (the order and deity assignments fully reverse). Traditional D30 analysis also weighs WHICH of these five division-lords governs a given degree — a separate technique not covered by this file, which interprets only the resulting sign placement (as with the other 11 vargas here).

verification_pass.method: Same methodology check as the other 11 files, plus a targeted check of the D30 Trimshamsha five-planet division scheme referenced in this file's calculation_note.
changes_made: Replaced the vague 'unequal degree spans per classical rule' description with the verified exact Parashara scheme: ODD signs — Mars 0-5°, Saturn 5-10°, Jupiter 10-18°, Mercury 18-25°, Venus 25-30°; EVEN signs — Venus 0-5°, Mercury 5-12°, Jupiter 12-20°, Saturn 20-25°, Mars 25-30° (fully reversed order and spans). Confirmed via two independent sources agreeing exactly.
verification_pass.unchanged_after_verification: The dignity-table methodology and the misfortune/weakness domain framing were both confirmed unchanged. The existing caveat that D30 also traditionally weighs which of the five planetary division-lords governs a given degree (a separate technique this file doesn't implement) was confirmed accurate and left in place.

owner_review_pass.method: Owner instructed Claude to run the online-source verification pass and mark items verified on that basis, without a separate manual line-by-line read-through — reasonable here because every item is systematically derived from the same small set of verified inputs (dignity table, sign meta, domain lens) rather than independently authored, so verifying those inputs verifies the whole file the same way it did for house_lord_placement.json and vimshottari_antardasha.json earlier in this project.
owner_review_pass.outcome: Approved. All 108 items marked verified: true.

items.title: Sun in Aries in the Trimshamsha (D30)
items.summary: Exalted — colors misfortunes and weaknesses through Aries's initiation.
